facts.fact: A Benin official lists an electronic certificate among the foundations of the national platform, beside identity, data exchange, single portal and payment.

MRT.note: The 2021 e-wallet law concerns payments; no authentication service stated.

facts.fact: A Benin official says no platform is delivered without a battery of tests by the national cybersecurity centre.
A Mauritanian official says a national cybersecurity certification agency came into being in 2025.

facts.fact: A Benin official names a data exchange platform among the foundations of its digital state, beside identity, single portal, e-certificate and payment.

facts.fact: A Benin official says Beninese data stays in Benin, and the country ran two years without a maintenance contract with no service interruption.

MRT.note: A planned law to open public data is not a rule on state data hosting.

facts.fact: A Benin official says the national platform, launched in March 2020 with five services, now has over 210 services digitalised end to end.
A Mauritanian official claims about forty transactional online services, of nearly 900 targeted.
A Benin official says more than 99% of the population has a digital identity.
A Benin official says the digital identity is now assigned from birth.
